links.outcome: AI diagnostic and treatment concordance versus board-certified clinicians on same encounters
links.effect: Top diagnosis matched in 81% of cases; treatment plan aligned in 99.2%; in discordant cases AI superior in 36.1%, human superior in 9.3%.
links.quote: The top diagnosis of Doctronic and clinician matched in 81% of cases, and the treatment plan aligned in 99.2% of cases.

links.outcome: Agent performance on historical telehealth encounters against clinician reference
links.effect: 81% top-diagnosis concordance and 99.2% treatment plan alignment across 500 consecutive encounters; no clinical hallucinations.
links.quote: No clinical hallucinations occurred (e.g., diagnosis or treatment not supported by clinical findings).

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates the clinical decision-making performance and concordance of an autonomous multi-agent LLM framework (Doctronic) against board-certified clinicians on 500 consecutive urgent care telehealth encounters.
